title: console: a person-triggered "Duplicate record" action, whose copy takes hand-locked fields' defaults (the rule ruled on #36806, no surface today)
body:
repo:objectstack#8 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSAaBEfQpU2yJexSJ8

Filing gate: ② (a capability for the maintainer's priority; carries a ruled rule) · Source: fleet — item 4 of #37402, measured "no surface" on PR #38169 and analysed independently (fable tier) as Q3 of that card.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：裁决里说「在控制台复制一条已确认的记录，得到的是草稿」,但控制台今天根本没有给人用的「复制记录」,只有接口能复制，而接口按裁决不算人手。
- 选项：这张卡只是把规则挂在将来的复制功能上;现在不做，等有人要时再排。
- 推荐：先放着(p3),不做;以后谁做控制台复制，这条规则就是它的验收条件。
- 不定会怎样：规则没有着落，将来做复制时可能悄悄复制出第二张「已确认」的单子。

## What

- The ruling on #36806 (comment 7180466652) counts "duplicating a record from the console" as a hand edit and asks that the copy take each hand-locked field's `defaultValue` (filed onto #37402 as item 4).
- Measured on PR #38169: the console has no person-triggered record duplicate (only `POST /data/:object/:id/clone`, an API write the ruling keeps). `enable.clone` (`object.zod.ts:445`) is read only by that REST door. So #37402 closes with item 4 "no surface, not delivered".
- This card holds the rule for the surface when it is built: a console Duplicate action whose copy takes the hand-locked fields' defaults (with a field's own override winning), honouring `enable.clone`.

## Business reason

Every mainstream platform offers record Duplicate, and the platform already declares the capability and a toggle a person cannot see. Without this card, a future Duplicate built without the rule mints a second confirmed document silently.

## Reader who acts

A ui lane seat, when the maintainer schedules console Duplicate. ⛔ Not built now (zero measured askers).

## Dedupe

`is:issue duplicate record console` / `is:issue clone record action ui` → only #37402.

Grade: area:data · Feature · p3 · reach: none today (no surface); guards a future console action
